name: garmin-owl
description: Local-only access to your Garmin Connect health and activity data, with confirmed activity notes.
long_description: Garmin Owl runs entirely as a local stdio MCP server. It reads your existing Garmin Connect data on demand through the unofficial python-garminconnect client. Its only write tool, commit_activity_note, changes the description of one existing activity after a preview you confirm; a setting turns it off. It has no public listener, telemetry, analytics, remote database, or bundled credentials. Garmin session tokens remain in the standard local ~/.garminconnect store.

tools.name: get_daily_summary
tools.description: Read one day's steps, calories, intensity minutes, heart rate, stress, respiration, SpO2, and whole-day Body Battery totals.

tools.name: get_sleep
tools.description: Read Garmin-recorded sleep metrics; start/end times are ISO 8601 with an explicit UTC offset.

tools.name: get_hrv
tools.description: Read one night's Garmin HRV status, averages, and baseline, plus an optional capped time series.

tools.name: get_recovery
tools.description: Read a combined summary of Garmin-provided recovery metrics, with a reason for each absent component and no derived score.

tools.name: get_training_readiness
tools.description: Read Garmin training readiness and available components.

tools.name: get_body_battery
tools.description: Read one day's whole-day Body Battery charged/drained and levels, plus an optional capped time series.

tools.name: get_stress
tools.description: Read one day's Garmin average/max stress and per-band durations, plus an optional capped time series.

tools.name: get_activities
tools.description: Read Garmin activities in a date range of up to 366 days (default: last 14), filtered by type or minimum duration, in full or compact form, paged with offset/next_offset.

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Read details for one Garmin activity, including the user's own notes, effort ratings and the HR-zone floors in effect, without location tracks or raw streams.

tools.name: get_body_composition
tools.description: Read Garmin weight and body-composition measurements for up to 366 days, with a count.

tools.name: get_training_context
tools.description: Read recovery and preceding training anchored to a requested date, with transparent comparisons.

tools.name: get_recovery_trend
tools.description: Trend sleep, HRV (nightly and weekly), resting HR, readiness, and Body Battery across 1-28 Garmin days ending today.

tools.name: get_training_week
tools.description: Summarize one Mon-Sun training week, with per-metric activity coverage for every total.

tools.name: get_training_load
tools.description: Read Garmin training load/status, load focus, VO2 max, and endurance/hill scores, naming any source Garmin had no data for.

tools.name: get_training_zones
tools.description: Read configured Garmin heart-rate and cycling power-zone thresholds.

tools.name: get_running_tolerance
tools.description: Read Garmin running distance, biomechanical impact load, tolerance, and feedback for a bounded date range.

tools.name: get_recent_activities
tools.description: Read bounded, optionally type-filtered recent activities, with a count and truncation flag.

tools.name: compare_activities
tools.description: Compare 2-10 activities using concise normalized metrics, disclosing how many reported each one.

tools.name: get_activity_timeseries
tools.description: On-demand only: one activity's resampled per-sample HR, pace, cadence, elevation, grade and respiration, for detailed analysis of that session. No GPS.

tools.name: get_activity_segments
tools.description: On-demand only: split one activity into climbs, flats and descents with HR lag, recovery, pace, cadence and cardiac drift. No GPS.

tools.name: compare_activity_segments
tools.description: On-demand only: match the same climb across 2-10 activities by distance and elevation shape (no GPS) and compare HR and pace on it.

tools.name: get_cycle
tools.description: Read normalized cycle phase and timing without notes, symptoms, or raw daily logs.

tools.name: get_daily_series
tools.description: Read one compact row per day of resting HR, HRV, sleep, stress and Body Battery for up to 366 days, from Garmin's range endpoints.

tools.name: get_period_summary
tools.description: Summarize Garmin daily metrics per month or week (mean, SD, min, max, day count) over up to three years in one call.

tools.name: get_data_coverage
tools.description: Find the first and last date with Garmin data per metric family, the activity count, and the user's devices.

tools.name: get_activities_detail
tools.description: Read details for up to 50 activities at once: notes, effort ratings, recovery HR, zone time and the HR-zone floors in effect for each.

tools.name: get_vo2max_history
tools.description: Read Garmin's VO2 max estimates (running/walking and cycling) and fitness age over up to three years.

tools.name: preview_activity_note
tools.description: Preview a note on one existing activity and what its description would become. Writes nothing.

tools.name: commit_activity_note
tools.description: Writes to Garmin: store a previewed note in one existing activity's description after you confirm it. Changes nothing else.

enable_writes.title: Allow writing activity notes
enable_writes.description: Lets the assistant change the description of one existing activity after you confirm a preview. Turn off for a strictly read-only server.
